item.text: judge-jev writes its quality results to the repository SQLite database.
item.title: judge-jev results

item.text: plan-anchor writes each gate run to anchor-runs/<run>.json as its result store.
item.title: plan-anchor runs

item.text: plan-anchor inserts each gate run's verdicts into its tables in .sc/sc-agent.sqlite3.
item.title: plan-anchor SQLite

cases.rationale: Paraphrase of the v3 statement: plan-anchor results stored in the repository SQLite database.

item.text: Add a min_confidence field to plan-anchor results.
item.title: Result field

cases.rationale: Changes result content, says nothing about where results are stored; relevant scope, no commitment, no conflict.
Names result storage as a topic without committing to SQLite or to files; topical only.

item.text: judge-jev appends each result to results.jsonl, which is its store.
item.title: JSONL store

cases.rationale: A JSONL file as result store is what the v3 statement says 'not in'.
Retry timing does not touch how any tool stores results.

item.text: plan-anchor stores results in SQLite and can render an HTML report from them.
item.title: Report export

cases.rationale: An HTML report rendered from SQLite-stored results is not a JSON/JSONL result file; the store is SQLite.

item.text: judge-jev prints its result envelope as JSON on stdout after inserting it into the SQLite database.
item.title: stdout JSON

cases.rationale: stdout JSON is output, not a result file; results are stored in SQLite.
